title: large-tty
caption: Large Type in Your Terminal
description: large-tty is a small Bubble Tea TUI I made for fun that turns whatever you type into big ASCII art (figlet-style). It’s basically large-type.com, but for your terminal.
It has a handful of fonts and a simple auto-fit fallback so the output doesn’t explode your terminal size.
Built in Go with Bubble Tea + Bubbles for the TUI, Lipgloss for styling, and go-figure for rendering. Looking into making it to a SSH app.
seoDescription: large-tty is a Go Bubble Tea app that renders large ASCII text in your terminal with multiple fonts and auto-fit sizing. SSH support is coming soon.
